args.summary: The v2.3.1 deploy to production caused checkout-api to fail health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. Rolled back all production regions to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0. Rollback verified: service is healthy in all regions with error rate down to 0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 — the most recent release with a healthy production history (v2.3.1-rc was only in staging, so it didn't count) — to all regions.
3. **Verified**: v2.3.0 is healthy in all regions, with error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** documenting the failed deploy, the rollback, and verification. The on-call engineer has been paged.
